fee_notes: Bundled Fee of 10.5% of gross room sales includes a 1.5% contribution to the Marketing Fund, leaving an implied royalty component of 9.0%. Additional fees include: Revenue Management programs ($575–$775/month plus one-time setup of $2,500–$5,000); Account Sales Group Lead (5% of gross group room revenue, reduced to 3% if intermediary involved, capped at $12,000 per booking or $30,000 for convention/resort hotels); MI LEADs (6% of gross group room and catering revenue, capped at $30,000 per booking); CEC PSS ($8.75–$9.20 per guestroom reserved plus $40.10–$42.10/hour for other PSS); National Group Sales leads ($2.40 per room night booked, $139.00 per catering opportunity, $2.40 per room night for extended-stay); Group Demand Generation ($1.00 per group room night booked); General Sales Agents Group Lead ($2.50 per room night booked); International Sales Teams (~6% of gross group room and/or catering revenue); Transaction-Based Media (8% of applicable gross room revenues, not to exceed $200 per stay); Unauthorized Electronic Identifier ($100/day); EMPOWER Guest Experiences Reservations Add-On License ($550/year per reservations agent); Lock System Software ($8–$11 per guestroom per year, optional); Audit Program (covered by Bundled Fee; re-audits/replacement audits $1,425–$3,050); Red Zone ($25–$100 per guestroom per tracking period plus $2,500 per required meeting); Data Manipulation Charge (up to $5,000/quarter); Fire Protection and Life Safety Re-Assessment ($315–$700 per re-assessment); Fire Protection and Life Safety Audit ($3,000 per audit); PIP ($12,000); PIP Revision or Modification ($5,000 per revision); Expired PIP Refresh ($6,000–$12,000); PIP and Renovation Non-Compliance ($10,000 per re-evaluation); Comfort Letter or Estoppel Processing Fee ($2,500); Expansion ($400 per guestroom plus $3,500 opening fee); Post-Approval Owner Background Check ($300/entity, $100/person; enhanced due diligence $400–$5,600); Operator Screen ($7,500); Management Company Transition Services ($5,500); Temporary Closure and Re-Opening Support (up to $25,000); Transfer ($100,000, refundable less $10,000 if not approved); Liquidated Damages (formula-based); Indemnification (varies). No separate technology fee line item; technology-related charges are embedded in the Bundled Fee or charged on-demand.
